title: Use the backend's conversation system
description:
The backend defines endpoints to use for conversation flows.
They provide ways for a client to start a flow and be given exact instructions as to what to present to the user and what path the user can take. This app needs to remain dumb and rely on the backend for controlling the conversation flows.

All the information about the backend endpoints is both in the `swagger.json` as well as the generated `src/generated/backend/services/ConversationsService.ts` and the models `src/generated/backend/models/ConversationErrorDto.ts`, `src/generated/backend/models/ConversationPromptDto.ts`, `src/generated/backend/models/ConversationResponseDto.ts`, `src/generated/backend/models/ConversationSuccessDto.ts`, `src/generated/backend/models/HandleInputDto.ts` , `src/generated/backend/models/StartFlowDto.ts`,
`src/generated/backend/models/PromptFieldDto.ts`,
`src/generated/backend/models/PromptOptionDto.ts` and
 `src/generated/backend/models/MessageDto.ts` .

As always make sure you adhere to `docs/CODE_STANDARD.md` and `docs/TESTING.md` .

features.title: Update Session Store for Conversation State
features.description: Modify `src/lib/sessionStore.ts` to include a `conversationState` property in the `SessionData` interface. This state will store the active `flowId` and any other necessary context to maintain a user's position within a conversation flow across multiple messages. Initialize it as null or undefined for existing and new sessions.

features.title: Create a Generic Conversation Manager
features.description: Create a new file `src/conversations/conversationManager.ts`. This file will export a primary function, `handleConversationMessage`, that takes a Telegram message and the user's session. This function will check the session for an active `conversationState`. If one exists, it will package the user's message into a `HandleInputDto` and call the `ConversationsService.conversationsControllerHandleInput` endpoint. It will also need to handle the various response types (`ConversationPromptDto`, `ConversationSuccessDto`, `ConversationErrorDto`).

features.title: Implement a Backend Prompt Renderer
features.description: Create a new file `src/conversations/promptRenderer.ts`. This module will export a function that takes a `ConversationPromptDto` and a `bot` instance. It will be responsible for parsing the DTO's messages and fields, formatting them into a user-friendly string, and generating an inline keyboard for any `PromptOptionDto`s provided. It will then send the formatted message and keyboard to the user.

features.title: Integrate Conversation Manager into Message and Callback Handlers
features.description: Modify `src/index.ts`. In the `bot.on('message', ...)` handler, call the new `handleConversationMessage` function. If the function indicates that the message was handled as part of an active conversation, the subsequent command/message processing should be skipped. Similarly, update the `bot.on('callback_query', ...)` handler to delegate callbacks that are part of a conversation to the new manager.

features.title: Migrate /profile Command to Use Conversation Service
features.description: Update the `/profile` command handler in `src/index.ts`. Instead of triggering the old `profile.ts` flow, it should now call `ConversationsService.conversationsControllerStartFlow` with the `flowId` for updating a profile. The initial `ConversationPromptDto` response should be processed by the `promptRenderer`, and the new `conversationState` should be saved to the user's session.

features.title: Migrate /newgoal Command to Use Conversation Service
features.description: Update the `/newgoal` command handler in `src/index.ts` to use the new conversation system. It should call `ConversationsService.conversationsControllerStartFlow` with the appropriate `flowId`. The response should be rendered, and the conversation state saved, effectively replacing the logic in `src/flows/newGoal.ts`.

features.title: Handle Conversation Completion and Errors
features.description: Enhance `conversationManager.ts` to fully handle `ConversationSuccessDto` and `ConversationErrorDto`. When a success or error response is received from the backend, the manager should send the relevant message to the user and, crucially, clear the `conversationState` from the user's session to properly terminate the flow.

features.title: Remove Old Flow Logic and Files
features.description: Once the `/profile` and `/newgoal` commands are fully migrated and tested with the new conversation system, delete the now-obsolete files `src/flows/profile.ts` and `src/flows/newGoal.ts`. Also, remove any related import statements and calls to their functions from `src/index.ts`.
